# beenfar_adapters (Data Source)

The device adapters registered with the controller. Needs an admin's API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Needs an admin's API token.
data "beenfar_adapters" "all" {}

output "unhealthy_adapters" {
  value = [for a in data.beenfar_adapters.all.adapters : a.name if !a.healthy]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `adapters` (Attributes List) Registered adapters, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--adapters))

<a id="nestedatt--adapters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `adapters`

Read-Only:

- `healthy` (Boolean) Whether the adapter is connected and healthy.
- `kind` (String) `builtin` or `external`.
- `name` (String) Adapter name, e.g. `unifi`.
- `status_message` (String) Why the adapter is unhealthy, if it is.
- `version` (String) Adapter version.
